<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915360_theRebbe_171" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915360_theRebbe_171__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Specifically through the service in the present time of the heels of Moshiach, when darkness covers the earth, one reaches the revelations of the future redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">And based on all the above, it will be understood that specifically through the service now in the time of the heels of Moshiach, when "darkness will cover the earth"69</t>
    <t s="3">one comes to the revelations of the future redemption.</t>
    <t s="4">For specifically in this time,</t>
    <t s="5">when one must deal with sparks of holiness that have fallen into an impure place,</t>
    <t s="6">and one must turn bitterness into sweetness and darkness into light,</t>
    <t s="7">and even to the point that from time to time one goes out from the four cubits of Torah,</t>
    <t s="8">or from the four cubits of prayer,</t>
    <t s="9">to leave the synagogue and the study hall,</t>
    <t s="10">and in the language of the Shulchan Aruch: "Treat them with a manner of derech eretz"70,</t>
    <t s="11">nevertheless, specifically through the service now one brings about the future redemption,</t>
    <t s="12">for then will be fulfilled what is stated71</t>
    <t s="13">"And you will be gathered one by one,"</t>
    <t s="14">each and every one of Israel and all of Israel,</t>
    <t s="15">"and their silver and their gold with them"72,</t>
    <t s="16">with all the sparks of holiness that belong to them, and also those found in their silver and gold literally.</t>
    <t s="17">Because in this service during the time of exile there is the matter of mesiras nefesh to the utmost.</t>
    <t s="18">And it is known from the teaching of our master the Alter Rebbe</t>
    <t s="19">(and at length in the maamarim of the Nasi of our generation, my master, father-in-law, and teacher, the Rebbe73)</t>
    <t s="20">on the verse74</t>
    <t s="21">"And the man Moshe was very humble, more than any man upon the face of the earth,"</t>
    <t s="22">that the humility of Moshe</t>
    <t s="23">(Moshe is truth and his Torah is truth75)</t>
    <t s="24">was specifically connected to the generation of the heels of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="25">when he saw their mesiras nefesh in the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos in the matter of "do not be ashamed before those who mock"76</t>
    <t s="26">etc. and the like.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This brings about the fulfillment of the promise that the humble will rejoice in G-d, the joy of the true and complete redemption brought specifically through spreading the wellsprings outward.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this brings about the fulfillment of the promise: "And the humble will add joy in Hashem"77,</t>
    <t s="1">"everlasting joy upon their heads"78,</t>
    <t s="2">the joy of the true and complete redemption,</t>
    <t s="3">which comes specifically through the spreading of the wellsprings outward79,</t>
    <t s="4">and in a manner of "they are redeemed immediately"80</t>
    <t s="5">and in a manner of "He redeemed [them] in peace,"</t>
    <t s="6">without any exertion,</t>
    <t s="7">until the promise will be fulfilled81</t>
    <t s="8">"And kings will be your caretakers and their princesses your nurses,"</t>
    <t s="9">"and they will bring"82</t>
    <t s="10">"all your brothers etc. as an offering to Hashem etc. in a pure vessel etc.,"</t>
    <t s="11">very soon,</t>
    <t s="12">in the days of the final exile83,</t>
    <t s="13">and afterwards, immediately and completely in actuality, in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our righteousness,</t>
    <t s="14">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
